name: ads-dashboard
title: Ads Dashboard
description: A dark metrics dashboard: an alert drops in and the key metric falls in red, then cards pop in, the numbers recover and count up, and a chart line draws itself.
useWhen: An ad service, a creator's channel report or a data lesson needs a before-and-after metric story.
Numbers should feel like they recover: a red drop followed by a lime climb.
avoidWhen: You need a real chart from data: use animated-line-chart or animated-bar-chart.
The tone is light or playful: this is a dark, technical look.
author: Mosio
